result.title: Ultimate3D: Teaching Multimodal LLMs 3D Camera-Object Relations by Large-Scale Visual Instruction Data
result.comment: Accepted to Machine Vision and Applications 2027
result.summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle with accurately capturing camera-object relations, especially for object orientation, camera viewpoint, and camera shots. This stems from the fact that existing MLLMs are trained on images with limited diverse camera-object relations and corresponding textual descriptions. To address this, we propose a synthetic generation pipeline to create large-scale 3D visual instruction datasets. Our framework takes 3D assets as input and uses rendering and diffusion-based image generation models to create photorealistic images preserving precise camera-object relations. Additionally, large language models (LLMs) are used to generate text prompts for guiding visual instruction tuning and controlling image generation. We create Ultimate3D, a large-scale 3D-grounded 2D visual instruction dataset. Ultimate3D consists of 240K VQAs with precise camera-object annotations, and corresponding benchmark. MLLMs fine-tuned on our proposed dataset outperform commercial models by a large margin, achieving an average accuracy improvement of 29.7% on camera-object relation recognition tasks. Our code, dataset, and benchmark will contribute to broad MLLM applications.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对多模态大模型难以把握相机与物体的关系（物体朝向、视点、景别），提出以 3D 资产为输入、结合渲染与扩散生成保持精确相机—物体关系的逼真图像，并用 LLM 生成提示词，构建含 24 万条 VQA 与标注的 Ultimate3D 数据集及基准，微调后在该识别任务上显著提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作本身是几何/空间关系识别的数据与基准，未涉及推理期状态；但其「3D 资产可控渲染 + 精确标注 + 文本提示控制」的构造方式，可能为 LVR 中可控视觉证据筛选与细粒度监督信号的构建提供可核查线索。
